descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Peve Starfish' Rare Peve Starfish Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Introduced by Piet Vergeldt, this maple is truly unique. In fact, "Peve" is a combination with his name which Piet uses for many of his introductions. 'Peve Starfish' forms a mid-sized dwarf reaching 6-8 ft in 20 years. Its small stature and its unique leaves that cup downward give the appearance of a "starfish". Peve Starfish leafs out as a bright red in the early spring maturing to a deep maroon. New growth flushes are again a bright red. In the autumn, 'Peve Starfish' will light up your landscape turning to a bright crimson red. This is one of our favorites of these new selections.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Peve Starfish'，珍稀 ‘Peve Starfish’ 日本枫，适生区 5-9。 该品种由 Piet Vergeldt 推出，是一个极具特色的日本枫。 实际上，“Peve” 即由其名字组合而来，Piet 在许多自己推出的品种中都使用这一前缀。 ‘Peve Starfish’ 形成中等大小的矮生株型，20 年可达 6-8 英尺。 其株形较小，且独特叶片向下杯卷，因此呈现出“海星”般的外观。 ‘Peve Starfish’ 早春展叶鲜红，随后成熟为深栗红色；新梢再次萌发时也会呈现鲜红色。 秋季则会点亮景观，转为鲜艳的深红色。 它是这些新选育品种中我们最喜爱的之一。 带有 MrMaple 标识的照片
